name: ContextLedger · B / Detect contradiction and drift

parameters.content:
## 01 · Compare evidence with approved versions
Treat recency and source authority as review context. Compare exact values and bind each request to an immutable evidence set.

## 02 · Open idempotent reviews
Reuse a case for the same evidence. Persist the queue entry and audit event in one transaction.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ revision: $('Read current knowledge state').first().json.revision, writes: $('Compare claims and propose reviews').first().json.writes }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $json.committed ? $('Compare claims and propose reviews').first().json : { httpCode: 409, payload: { status: 'state_changed', message: 'Refresh and retry.' } } }];
